column1: # CANDIDATE LIST ONLY (mcman_physical link). Global symbols defined in a first-party object and left undefined by no other
# input of the same link. relocs_in_own_object counts relocations against the symbol inside its own object
# (0 = no reference found anywhere in this link; >0 = used only inside its own file, so it could be static).
# in_final_elf=no means the linker dropped it (--gc-sections) or it was never extracted.
# Not checked here: other build variants (DS34), calls by name from crt0/linker script, IRX export tables in other links.
